messages:
Alicia M.: Heads-up — after the rollout we're seeing two distinct customer signals for the same endpoint: (1) a high-severity generation crash for long prompts, and (2) a performance regression causing p95 latency spikes. Customers flagged both but prefer a hotfix for the crash and can tolerate a slower cadence for perf work.
Ben (PM): +1 to separating them. Crash is a P0 hotpatch; perf regressed routes to backlog enhancement. We should confirm repro scope and rollback safety.
Chris (eng): I can triage the crash now. Initial stack traces point to a kv-cache boundary when sequence > 8192 tokens. Minimal repro attached here.
Dina (SRE): Noted. If it's kv-cache overflow, we should disable the new cache-merge heuristic on Dedicated as a quick mitigation. That can be rolled out as a canary to eu-west first.
Eli (QA): Can you paste the failing request? I'll write a tiny smoke test to run against canary.
Chris (eng): Repro snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-large-v2","prompt":"A... (9k tokens)"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY'``` Crash log: `kv_index_out_of_bounds at runtime.cc:421`.
Alicia M.: OK, proposal: (A) Hotpatch: roll back cache-merge heuristic and push a canary within 2 hours. Acceptance: no crash on the attached repro, and no customer errors for past 24h queries. (B) Follow-on: perf investigation tracked as enhancement with owner and benchmark targets.
Ben (PM): Timeline: hotpatch today -> ship EOD if canary metrics look good. Perf work: schedule in next sprint; assign SLO improvements and cost tradeoffs.
Chris (eng): I'll open a PR to flip the feature flag and include a migration note. If deploy-bot approves, Dina can promote after canary checks.
deploy-bot: CI passed for commit 1a2b3c. Canary deploy started in eu-west.
Dina (SRE): Canary metrics: errors -> 0 for repro traffic, p95 latency unchanged in eu-west after flip. Rolling to us-east in 30m. Adding traffic filters for customers who reported the crash.
Eli (QA): Ran smoke tests against canary (script attached). Repro call no longer crashes. Marking hotpatch as QA-approved. :white_check_mark:
Ben (PM): Great. I'll notify the affected customers with ETA and mitigation note. For the perf regression, let's capture a small benchmark: baseline vs post-rollout across 512/2048/8192 token windows and add to the enhancement ticket.
Alicia M.: Decision: split thread into two artifacts — hotpatch changelist (done) and an enhancement ticket for perf work with acceptance metrics: p95 < 250ms for 512 tokens, and cost delta < 15%. Assign to Chris and schedule a design review next Tue.
Chris (eng): A couple implementation notes for the perf ticket: consider async KV compaction and finer-grained batching knobs. I'll sketch options in the ticket.
Ben (PM): I'll create the enhancement ticket and include customer repro + benchmarks. Thanks everyone, closing this thread once the rollback is fully global and customers are notified.
Alicia M.: Thanks team! :thumbsup:
